## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.4.2

### Highlights
- 🔤 **Chat abbreviations** (`GG`, `GGNT`, `BRB`, `AFK`, `KOS`, Cyrillic `гг`, `спс`… about 350) are shown in full meaning in your language; a new setting lets you translate, expand in the original language, or keep them as they are.
- 📜 **Calm chat scrolling:** scrolling up no longer jumps to the bottom on new messages; a "New messages" button takes you back. Closing the chat jumps to the latest message.
- 🗑 **Safer "Clear" for waypoints:** a redesigned confirmation dialog with a tick box and an explicit confirm button.
- 🛡 **Much sturdier:** fuzzing, network-outage and soak testing uncovered and fixed a log-parser slowdown, damaged waypoint files, bad translation replies, lost settings on concurrent saves, and more.

### Fixed
- Global hotkeys (F8, F9, Ctrl+M, Escape) no longer fire outside the game.
- Deleted or renamed waypoints no longer return when the log is replayed.
- Overlay, map and lists keep their position on a second monitor; the waypoint list stays above the map.
- Translations no longer garble coordinates; offline mode is fast and keeps chat order; the API key is sent in a header.
- Settings: hotkey conflicts are refused with a message; update errors are plain and localized.
- Settings fall back to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SCUM_Chat_Translator` when the program folder is read-only.
- Many smaller fixes (see the changelog).

### First launch
Download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` (installed edition) or `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`; existing settings, points and players are kept.
